sentences.en: How about playing catch in the vacant lot near by?
sentences.zh: 我们去附近那块空地扔飞盘怎么样？

sentences.en: There are no more vacant lots in my neighborhood anymore.
sentences.zh: 我现在所在的这个街区已经没有空闲地块了。

sentences.en: Many children play in the vacant lot behind my house.
sentences.zh: 很多孩子在我家后面的空地上玩耍。

senses.zh: devoid of thought, reflection, or expression 心不在焉的
